title: Commit
description: A node in the version DAG: one op batch plus a full snapshot of the document after it (02 §7).

parents.description: Empty for the root commit, one parent otherwise. Never two in v1: there are no true merges (region.adopt instead).

snapshot.description: Uncompressed canonical JSON of the full document after this commit, content-addressed in the BlobCache (02 §7). zstd is a later optimisation (Q85).

candidateGroup.description: Candidates produced by one AI request share a group.
